summary: The daemon entry point (`startDaemonLocked`, packages/daemon/src/daemon/index.ts) builds ProcessManager with `run: runner` again, so a tmux tree close removes finished issues' jj workspaces instead of logging `runtime owns workspace cleanup but ProcessManager has no command runner` (the gap #1031 opened after LEGION-104). The ProcessManager constructor now throws `ProcessManager needs a command runner: the <runtime> runtime removes workspaces at tree close` when `runtime.removesWorkspacesOnTreeClose` is true and `run` is undefined; `workspaceCommandRunner`'s own throw stays. A startDaemon-level test (RED on the unfixed entry point, GREEN after) and a constructor-refusal test with a retaining-runtime companion assertion lock both in; one sentence in daemon AGENTS.md names the runner as a required dependency under a workspace-removing runtime.
tier: T1 — the deployed daemon ships a feature that does nothing in production (architect ruling; not T2)

acceptance3: Production (LEGION-104 acceptance 7) is `pending the operator's daemon restart on the merged fix` in the PR body's `Production:` line. Under the deployment instructions the restart is the operator session's step: after the merge lands, the implementer needs the architect to have the operator restart the daemon on the merged commit, then the next tree close's `removed the workspace of <KEY>` log line, `jj workspace list -R <clone>`, the absent directory, and another workspace's `jj log` get recorded on the PR (Production line + footer comment) and the issue (dispatch_message). Negative control already on record: the LEGION-6 close of 2026-09-14 23:00:27Z on the pre-fix daemon.
trickyParts: `jj split` keeps advancing the bookmark onto the empty working copy, so the first push needed `jj bookmark set legion/LEGION-163 -r @- --allow-backwards` (local-only: the bookmark had never been pushed, no `@origin` row) to point it at the described docs commit; `jj git push` refuses an undescribed empty commit.

The startDaemon-level test's runner must match `/tools/jj` (index.test.ts's `daemonEnvironment.commands.jj`): `createDaemonRunner` rewrites `jj` to that absolute path before the injected runner sees the command.
